caption:
do skin injections make skin firmer?

Not that the trials have shown. What they did show is more glow.

Glow or firmness: which one are you after? One word below.

One review pooled randomized trials of hyaluronic acid injections against a control (doi:10.1111/jocd.16760). Radiance improved across 3 trials with 307 people. Hydration improved too, but once one study was taken out, that result was no longer significant. Elasticity, the usual measure of firmness, showed no significant change across 3 trials with 299 people.

What this doesn't mean: that firmness can't improve. Three trials is a small base, and the products and doses weren't the same.

Save this before your next skin consult.

General education only.
